summary: Enerflex Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the timing of its first quarter 2026 financial results release on May 7, 2026, and a virtual investor update on May 27, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings calendar notice with no special-situation components such as acquisitions, divestitures, or management changes. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions are disclosed. The filing serves only to inform stakeholders of upcoming earnings and investor events, which is standard financial communications.
